finding.summary: The final caller asserts no outstanding criteria discrepancy but supplies grouped checklist assertions instead of the shared workflow's per-criterion authority/scope comparisons.

project/work/authoring-01/plan.json: working.frame-assembly adds lossless construction restrictions to output geometry. The chosen route supports them, but the caller does not distinguish method authority from required final geometry.

project/AUTHORING-RESULT.json: caller_comparison.outcome says agree with no outstanding discrepancy. The member-specific and no-reference-measurements checks summarize the group and discuss palette/alpha/stroke/margins, without resolving the above literal rules and their scope.

plugins/pixl/skills/pixl/references/request-review.md requires per-criterion comparisons and separation of required outcomes from chosen recipes; this procedure was not fully represented in the returned authoring handoff.
finding.interpretation: The deterministic recipe itself is coherent and independently checks out. The gap is adoption evidence: the caller has not established which stricter clauses are scoped expert choices and which remain required outcomes. This is not a finding that the proposed art is bad, nor a universal ban on method-specific criteria.
